Source says: Central Bank of Uruguay (Uruguay). Government of Uruguay appoints or directs the board of the Central Bank of Uruguay (Uruguay). Article 197 of the Constitution of Uruguay provides that where the Poder Ejecutivo considers the management or acts of the Directores of an ente autonomo inconvenient or unlawful it may make observations and suspend the acts observed, and that if the observations are disregarded it may order the rectifications, correctives or removals it sees fit, reporting them to the Senate. Article 198 adds that the Poder Ejecutivo may remove board members with the Senate's consent for ineptitude, omission or crime in office, that if the Senate does not rule within sixty days the Poder Ejecutivo may make the removal effective, and that such removals give no right of appeal to the Tribunal de lo Contencioso Administrativo. The Banco Central del Uruguay is an ente autonomo, and article 14 of its charter designates its directors under article 187 of this same chapter. Constitucion de la Republica de Uruguay, Seccion XI, Capitulo I (Justia Uruguay)

Source says: Bank of Guyana (Guyana). President of Guyana appoints or directs the board of the Bank of Guyana (Guyana). Under section 29 of the Bank of Guyana Act, Chapter 85:02 (Act No. 19 of 1998, enacted 31 December 1998), the Minister, in consultation with the Bank, specifies the policies, principles and criteria of Guyana's exchange rate system, and the Bank is responsible only for the day-to-day administration of that system. Section 14(2) of the same Act lets the President terminate the appointment of the Governor, and the Minister terminate the appointment of any other Director, on stated grounds. Section 3(1) describes the Bank as an autonomous institution governed by the Act. This record rests on the consolidated text of the Act published by Guyana's Ministry of Legal Affairs. The report quotes him saying that if a solution could not be found there would be no other choice but dismissal of the board. The report does not say who would carry out the dismissal.
